description: Tokenized Asset Purchase: submit a token’s redemption terms as written with the buyer: the rights with whether the token redeems, what it redeems into (the underlying asset, cash, a stablecoin or none), who may redeem (any holder, whitelisted holders, institutional holders or at the issuer’s discretion), the minimum in tokens, the notice and settlement days, the redemption fee, each gate, suspension, queue or cap the issuer may impose with its condition and limit, and the wording, read for redeem at any time, instant redemption, guaranteed, sole discretion or may suspend; the holder with the investor type, whether whitelisted, the tokens the buyer will hold and the days within which the buyer may need cash back; and past redemptions on record with each one’s id, date, status (paid, delayed, refused or suspended) and days. The signed report gives the rights with who may redeem against the buyer and the minimum against the holding, the timing with notice plus settlement days against the days the buyer may need, every gate with its condition, and the history, and counts them, and names a blocked redemption: no redemption right, redemption only at the issuer’s discretion, a buyer the terms do not let redeem, a holding under the minimum, a path slower than the buyer needs, refused or suspended redemptions on record and any-time wording the terms contradict; then gates and suspensions on the terms, delays on record and a redemption fee, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. Unstated rights, redemption target, redeemers, timing, minimum and the buyer’s type, holding or need leave the path unverified. This reads one token’s redemption terms against one buyer: rights fields the Atlas dataset marks not disclosed are wever_atlas-rights-gap. Verdict tokenized_redemption_blocked, tokenized_redemption_partial, tokenized_redemption_unverified or tokenized_redemption_open. POST /api/tokenized-redemption-check. Reads the purchase records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Tokenized Asset Purchase reads the buyer’s own records for one purchase of a tokenized asset and checks each step before money moves: the quote against its stated terms, the platform’s terms against the buyer, the custody arrangement, the redemption path, the transfer restrictions, the settlement, the claimed backing and the full cost. Beside it, wever_atlas-asset-passport and wever_atlas-redemption-check read what the published Tokenization Atlas dataset records about an asset by its id, while a purchase check reads the records the buyer supplies for one purchase; and wever_vendor-quote-check and wever_price-truth-check read quotes and charges for goods, services and paid calls, while the quote and cost checks read a token purchase against its own terms. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/tokenized-purchase-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/tokenized-asset-purchase/.

gates.description: Gates or suspensions the issuer may impose.

text.description: Read for wording such as redeem at any time, instant redemption, guaranteed, sole discretion or may suspend.
